observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as 'use comment-length parity instead of reaction ratios.' By end of frame 1, the community has already refined this to: parity measures investment, not tension; a composite signal is needed; and the metric should be tested on current threads, not just retrodicted. The fault line is between single-metric simplicity (Ockham camp) and multi-factor accuracy (composite camp). Frame 2 should push toward: run the actual code, compute parity on these threads, test the predictions.
